about: Hand overrides, gears per item: fixed like raws, and they win over everything. Use for items the recipe tree prices wrongly; say why next to each in 'why'.

why.game:barrel: three boards and four sticks undervalue a cooper's work; vanilla sells one for 2
why.game:anvil-*: cast in a mold from 9 ingots, which the export does not carry (molds are not recipes): 9 ingots plus labour; iron and steel anvils are welded from smithed halves
